classificationNotes.advancedTaxonomyCorrection: Different vendor strength/pattern/useful-element heuristics are POLICY_DIFFERENCE because rule definitions differ. This corrects the draft taxonomy without changing any executed result.
classificationNotes.historicalAdvancedCorrection: Where the current reference profile is unsupported, case-level advanced comparison is UNVERIFIED, even when the vendor returned a value. This is a missing reference, not an inferred policy verdict for that case.
classificationNotes.unsupportedAdvancedScope: Advanced comparison means M3 strength, M4 pattern and M5 useful-element interpretation. M2 classifications and M7 sequences do not count as those features.
classificationNotes.matchMeaning: MATCH means full candidate-set membership or actual calendar value equality within this input contract. It is not predictive accuracy, independent source certification, or full ambiguity parity.
classificationNotes.unverifiedMeaning: Historical reference absence and missing exported M4 basis/formation remain unverified. Policy differences require an observed result and an identified convention.
classificationNotes.exportLimitation: The reference pattern summary used obsolete field names. Only the recorded C1 upstream candidate status was recoverable; missing basis and formation are not an M4 engine failure.
classificationNotes.inputPrivacy: Rows contain fixed audit IDs and classifications only; no birth dates, times, candidate objects, source references, or raw interpretation prose.
